To accommodate travel and Vertex Health’s global attendees, we can stagger times (e.g., 9:00 PT / 13:00 PT).

I’m attaching a revised draft agenda and a one-page mutual action plan that lays out deliverables and success criteria. If Vertex prefers to keep it to a single session, Laura can run it in my stead; otherwise I can join live on Dec 20 (see proposed dates below).

Proposed options (please pick one):

- Option B (split days): Dec 20 & Dec 22 — Session A 9:00–10:30 PT, Session B 9:00–10:30 PT
